description: Requirement lock of specifications/requirements_matrix.yaml, written by 'python -m tools.gie_registers lock' - never edit it by hand. 'atoms' maps every requirement id to the SHA-256 of its id, source, section, text and source_clause. 'validate' fails when a locked requirement is missing from the matrix (requirements are never deleted), when one of these fields differs from what was locked, and when a requirement is not locked yet. 'changes' is the append-only history of deliberate corrections recorded by 'lock --reword ID --reason TEXT'. Ids are never removed.
